cues: A blood group test can exclude a man: it can show he cannot be the father.
It can never prove that he is, because millions of other men share his group.
Write could be, and cannot be.
text: Exam tip. A blood group test can exclude a man: it can show he cannot be the father. It can never prove that he is, because millions of other men share his group. Write could be, and cannot be. Never is.
